points: AI Office sent first requests for information on security, external evaluation and model use
AI Scientific Panel met 9 October on loss-of-control incidents; serious incident reports already received
Panel recommends governing internal models and a task force to investigate incidents
read: Speech by EVP Virkkunen, Dublin, 14 October
take: First enforcement under the AI Act targets frontier model makers after agent loss-of-control incidents. Expect tougher questions to your model vendors on containment and evaluation.
title: European Commission: AI Office opens first AI Act enforcement
